content.user_title: Track SEO Rankings and SERP Movement
content.value_statement: Ranking data becomes hard to trust when baselines, sources, and devices are mixed. This skill structures keyword tracking, delta analysis, and AI visibility checks with source labels.
actual_capabilities: Defines tracking settings for domain, market, device, language, frequency, and competitors.
Compares current keyword positions against prior baselines and labels each delta.
Tracks SERP feature ownership such as snippets, PAA, images, videos, and local packs.
Monitors AI visibility signals including AI Overview presence, citations, and citation position.
Separates measured, user-provided, and estimated metrics so reports show data quality.
Creates ranking reports with wins, drops, stable terms, lost rankings, and next actions.
limitations: Requires user-provided ranking data or connected SEO tools for measured results.
Cannot prove ranking causes without supporting technical, content, and competitor evidence.
Does not replace performance-monitor for automated alerts or broad stakeholder reporting.
AI visibility metrics require an AI monitoring source or manual observations.

use_cases.title: Weekly SEO Ranking Review
use_cases.description: Compare current keyword positions with the previous snapshot and summarize the biggest wins, declines, and next actions.

use_cases.title: SERP Feature Ownership Check
use_cases.description: Track whether a site owns snippets, image packs, local packs, or PAA results for priority keywords.

use_cases.title: AI Visibility Monitoring
use_cases.description: Record AI Overview presence and citation signals for important queries when AI monitoring data is available.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Keyword Tracking
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up rank tracking for my domain using these keywords. Ask for any missing market, device, language, and competitor details.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Ranking Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze ranking changes for this domain over the last period. Label each metric as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Review SERP Feature Movement
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare SERP feature ownership for these keywords and highlight snippets, PAA, image packs, videos, and local packs that changed.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Ranking Drops
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate these ranking drops against the baseline, competitors, known changes, and available AI visibility data. Give likely causes and recovery actions.

output_examples.input: Track rankings for example.com across ten priority keywords with Search Console positions and competitor notes.
output_examples.output: A ranking report with current position, baseline, delta, source tag, ranking URL, major movers, competitor threats, and recommended actions.

output_examples.input: Analyze why three priority keywords fell from page one during the last two weeks.
output_examples.output: A focused decline analysis that separates measured movement from likely causes, then lists technical, content, and competitor checks.

output_examples.input: Monitor AI visibility for product category queries where AI Overview data is available.
output_examples.output: An AI visibility summary showing presence, citation rate, citation position, unavailable metrics, trend direction, and follow-up recommendations.

best_practices: Use the same market, device, language, and source when comparing ranking snapshots.
Label every metric as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable.
Save confirmed snapshots only after user approval so future reports have reliable baselines.
anti_patterns: Do not invent previous positions when no baseline exists.
Do not present model estimates as measured ranking data.
Do not attribute ranking movement to one cause without supporting evidence.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a domain, target keywords, market context, and either ranking exports, connected tools, or user-provided positions.

faq.question: Can it work without paid SEO tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use user-provided positions and recorded snapshots, but measured exports give stronger evidence.

faq.question: Does it monitor AI search visibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It can track AI Overview presence and citation metrics when an AI monitoring source or manual observation is available.

faq.question: Can it explain why rankings changed?
faq.answer: It can suggest likely causes, but it should label them as hypotheses unless supporting evidence is available.

faq.question: Does it create automated alerts?
faq.answer: No. The skill directs automated recurring monitoring and alerts to performance-monitor.

faq.question: How should saved results be handled?
faq.answer: Ask before saving. Store approved snapshots in the declared monitoring memory path so future comparisons use a clear baseline.
